improvement: A reported-end-date follow-up can now request next calendar year in English or French while retaining the selected FONGIM, World Bank or EU project identifiers. The relative period is frozen to an explicit year before fresh source retrieval.
reproduced_before: Follow-ups such as 'Which of those projects end next year?' and 'Lesquels de ces projets ont une date de fin l’année prochaine ?' returned no structured resolution even though the date engine already supported calendar-year selection.

qualification.fresh_retrieval_guard: Only selected source identifiers, a previously established active-only constraint, and the newly resolved calendar year carry forward. Prior dates, statuses, reach claims and other source-family identifiers are excluded.
qualification.period_guard: Next year and French next-year forms are converted to the next UTC calendar year. Compound, conflicting and rolling-plus-calendar periods defer to semantic resolution.
qualification.ambiguity_guard: A mixed roster without an explicitly named source family remains ambiguous.
qualification.api_guard: The next-calendar-year path skips semantic rewriting and invokes one fresh research lookup in the API test.

deployment.blocker: Exact-SHA deployment to the authorised V4 test service requires a signed-in dashboard session. Generic deployment remains unsafe because the configured source branch is older and divergent.
deployment.next_action: Deploy published_code_commit to V4 test only, then live-test English and French next-calendar-year follow-ups, mixed-roster source selection, active-only continuity, fresh citations, FONGIM selected ID 664, and Mali 815 to Gao 44.

rollback.database: No schema or data change. Retain the existing additive evaluation schema and reviewed source facts.

continuity.do_not_repeat: Do not rebuild the active-only, empty-subset, French catalogue, mixed-source, explicit-range or next-calendar-year fixes. Reconcile the latest candidate branch and service before exact-SHA deployment.
continuity.if_deployment_still_blocked: Continue the next bounded Q-006 topic-change or supported-time-filter continuity case after reproducing it.

preservation: Accepted PADEL publication, FONGIM selection, geography, source catalogue, response, dossier and account behavior retained; no database, source record, service configuration, access, production or administration change.
limitations: Only recognised reported-end-date follow-up wording and unambiguous English or French next-calendar-year forms use this deterministic path.
Long or truncated rosters, more than twelve identifiers, unnamed mixed-source sets, compound periods and analytical cross-source questions continue through semantic resolution.
No live acceptance, actual-database qualification or full model benchmark was performed.
spending: All qualification was local and made no external model or research calls.
